items.title: Vacate the apartment / end of tenancy
items.quote: Namens und in Vollmacht unserer Mandanten kündigen wir das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Innstraße 21, Erdgeschoss, ordentlich zum 31.05.2027.
items.computation: The notice letter was personally delivered by courier on 19.11.2026 (dropped in the mailbox 9:15 Uhr), which is after the 3rd working day of November 2026 (04.11.2026 – Mon 02, Tue 03, Wed 04). Under §573c(1) BGB a termination received after the 3rd working day of a month is treated as received in the following month, i.e. December 2026. The base statutory notice period of 3 months is extended by 3 months because the tenant has occupied the flat since July 2020 (more than 5 years), giving a total notice period of 6 months, which ends at the close of the month that is 5 months after the base month (December + 5 = May 2027). This matches the date the landlords' lawyer states explicitly: 31.05.2027 (a Monday). The tenant must have vacated and returned the flat by this date.

items.title: Deadline to object (Widerspruch) to the termination under §§574-574b BGB
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens zwei Monate vor dem Ende des Mietverhältnisses zugehen.
items.computation: The tenancy ends 31.05.2027 as stated in the letter. §574b BGB requires any objection (in Textform) asserting hardship under §§574-574a BGB to reach the landlords (via their lawyer) at least two calendar months before that end date. Two months before 31.05.2027 is 31.03.2027, a Wednesday – a normal business day, so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is needed. Confirmed with Ordnung's compute_deadline tool (bgb_574b rule).
